_about: The base every OTO ontology extends: the temporal fields that make supersession work, and Document, the class every fact cites. Extend it; do not start a domain from it alone.
_summary: The temporal vocabulary every OTO ontology rests on, and the one class every fact cites: Document.
name: OTO core

Document.definition: A source document in the corpus: the file a fact cites, with its own date.

Action.definition: Something that can be done about an entity, described the way an MCP server describes a tool and bound to the graph. OTO lists it; the caller invokes it; the recorded run is evidence.

cites.definition: This document refers to that one, so a fact traced to it can be traced one step further.

acts_on.definition: The entity a recorded run of this action read or changed.

executed_by.definition: Who is accountable for invoking this action: a team, never a person.

asOf.definition: When this fact was recorded or observed (transaction time).

validFrom.definition: When the fact became true in the world (valid time).

validTo.definition: When the fact stopped being true. Absent means it still holds.

supersededBy.definition: The newer fact that retired this one.

sourceDoc.definition: Slug of the document that introduced or changed this fact.
sourceDoc.label: source document
